reasoning_quality_informational.v1_root_problem: Since August, billing dispute tickets have doubled (E-05) even though Customer Service is already answering tickets within SLA (E-01: median 1.6d, p90 2.8d vs 3.0d SLA) — ruling out slow response as the cause. The best-supported mechanism (H-IMPORT-RULE-CHANGE, SUPPORTED) is that billing import validation rules changed around August, producing incorrect bills across both ACTUAL and ESTIMATED read types; disputed bills skew toward ACTUAL reads (1785 vs 1240, E-03), which rules out estimate-substitution/field-staffing as the dominant driver and, combined with the absence of any logged tariff change (E-04, E-06), points to an import/calculation-side billing defect as the root cause of the ticket surge.
